name: Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce
author: Easy Payment

sections.description:
Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce enables you to accept online payments effortlessly on your WooCommerce store using Razorpay Payment Gateway.

This plugin integrates with Razorpay’s secure and PCI-compliant payment system, allowing customers to pay using:
✔ UPI (Unified Payments Interface)
✔ Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Rupay, etc.)
✔ Net Banking (All major banks supported)
✔ Wallets (Paytm, PhonePe, Mobikwik, etc.)

Why Choose Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce?
– One-Click Payment Experience: Customers stay on your store while completing payments.
– Automatic Order Status Updates: Orders automatically update when payments are confirmed.
– Seamless UPI Integration: Accept UPI payments instantly without redirections.
– No Redirects: Customers complete payments on your site, improving conversion rates.
– Mobile-Friendly & Fast: Optimized for high-speed mobile payments.

Boost your WooCommerce sales with a fast, secure, and reliable payment gateway powered by Razorpay.

Key Features

✅ Secure & PCI-Compliant – Fully encrypted transactions with Razorpay security.
✅ Multiple Payment Options – UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets.
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Works with WooCommerce checkout for a smooth payment experience.
✅ Fast & Easy Setup – Just enter your Razorpay API Key & Secret, and you’re ready to go!
✅ Automatic Order Processing – Orders are marked Processing or Completed after successful payments.
✅ Mobile & Desktop Optimized – Works seamlessly across all devices.
✅ No Hidden Fees – Razorpay’s standard transaction fees apply, with no extra charges.

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the plugin.
  2. Enter your Razorpay API Key & Secret in WooCommerce settings.
  3. Enable Razorpay as a payment method in WooCommerce.
  4. Customers can now pay using UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets securely!

That’s it! Your WooCommerce store is now powered by Razorpay!

External Services

This plugin integrates with Razorpay to process payments and onboard merchants.

It connects to the following Razorpay services:

  • https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js
    Used to render the Razorpay payment form during checkout.

  • https://api.razorpay.com/v1/
    Used to create and verify orders, process payments, and handle webhooks.

  • https://rzp.io/
    Used during merchant onboarding to link or register a Razorpay account.

Data Sent:
– For payments: customer name, email, phone number, order ID, order amount, currency, billing/shipping address.
– For onboarding: merchant email, phone, and account information required by Razorpay.

These services are essential for secure payment transactions and Razorpay account setup.

Service Provider: Razorpay Software Private Limited
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy

Support & Feedback

📩 Need help? Visit our support page.
🌟 Enjoying the plugin? Leave us a review!

For more details, see GPL-2.0 License.
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install

    • Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
    • Search for “Easy Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce”.
    • Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.

  2. Configure Razorpay

    • Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
    • Click on Razorpay and enter your API Key & Secret.

  3. Enable Razorpay Payment Gateway

    • Make sure Razorpay is enabled as a payment method.

  4. Test the Payment Flow

    • Place a test order and confirm smooth transactions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support UPI payments?

Yes! Customers can pay via UPI seamlessly, making transactions fast and secure.

Do I need a Razorpay account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a Razorpay merchant account to generate API credentials. You can sign up here.

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, this plugin is 100% free, but Razorpay’s standard transaction fees apply based on your pricing plan.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No! The plugin is lightweight & optimized for fast performance.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes! Razorpay is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant, ensuring secure payment processing.
